Unnamed Really Cool Community (URCC)

Welcome to URCC! We are a casual and cozy survival server built around the Create mod and its various addons. Whether you are a master engineer or just getting started with your first mechanical press, our community provides the perfect space to build, automate, and relax.

What we offer:

Create-Centric Gameplay: Experience Minecraft like never before with custom automation, machinery, and aesthetic building possibilities provided by the Create mod and our curated addon selection.

We offer an extremely fast support! you can join get help with anything by opening ticket in our discord server https://discord.gg/KSF6XDfWuv

### **_Casual Survival: Our core gameplay is survival, but we believe in a stress-free experience. If you find yourself in need of small items, such as specific decoration blocks or a starter amount of wood—our community and staff are happy to help you get back on your feet with creative suppliments._**

### Community-Driven: We love hearing from our players! The server is open to mod suggestions and community feedback to ensure everyone has a voice in how we grow.

Cozy Atmosphere: URCC is built for players who want to build cool things in a laid-back, non-toxic environment.

Getting Started This server requires a specific modpack to join.

Version: 1.21.1 NEOFORGE

How to join: Ensure you have installed our required modpack via the Modrinth app or your preferred launcher. The pack will be marked as "Required" when you attempt to connect to the server.

Join the Community Want to suggest a mod, chat with other engineers, or get help with the modpack? Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/KSF6XDfWuv

We can't wait to see what you build!
